scripts.lint:python: uv run --project backend --locked ruff check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend scripts
scripts.format:python:check: uv run --project backend --locked ruff format --config backend/pyproject.toml --check backend scripts
scripts.check: npm run check:toolchain && npm run format:check && npm run lint:python && npm run format:python:check
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend --locked uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.test:backend: uv run --project backend --locked pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests
